tagline: Materialize SQL datasets (Beta): Dashboard materialization now covers SQL datasets in addition to local metric views, so you can materialize a dashboard's SQL datasets.
what_it_does: Materialize SQL datasets (Beta): Dashboard materialization now covers SQL datasets in addition to local metric views, so you can materialize a dashboard's SQL datasets. Select multiple tables when adding a data source: You can now select multiple tables at the same time in the Add data source picker when building a dashboard data model. Numeric window measures: Numeric window measures are now generally available in the low code metric view UI.
why_it_matters: Scheduling dashboard updates ensures that your dashboards display up to date information and improves performance for end users.
